title: Ground States and Periodic--to--Localized Convergence in Two--Dimensional Saturable Discrete Nonlinear Schrödinger Equations
summary: We study a two--dimensional discrete nonlinear Schrödinger equation with saturable nonlinearity on the lattice $\mathbb Z^2$. Using a variational approach based on the Nehari manifold, we establish the existence of nontrivial periodic ground states on finite lattices and establish the existence of exponentially localized ground states in $\ell^2(\mathbb Z^2)$.
